ideas.name: any warning calling toward the developing POC
ideas.why: today's most-traded price so far is the day's balance; a sibling of batch 23's IB midpoint

ideas.name: any warning calling toward the day's midpoint
ideas.why: the middle of today's range so far, after 09:00; a sibling of the IB midpoint that moves with the day

ideas.name: any warning calling toward the session VWAP
ideas.why: the average price of everyone since 17:00, overnight included; a sibling of the overnight midpoint

ideas.name: any warning in the 30 minutes before a release
ideas.why: before a red-folder release traders flatten and wait, so moves do not follow through and turns rotate

ideas.name: any warning on a day already full of warnings
ideas.why: after 12 or more warnings today the box keeps calling turns that come: a rotating day
